task: W02 broadcast and marketing source follow-up review
scope: Independent visual and source-use review of CAST-05 generations-001/-002, CAST-06 generation-001, CAST-07 generation-001, MKT-01 generation-001, MKT-02 generation-001, and MKT-08 generation-001. The seven declared source PNGs were opened with view_image. The review covers text legibility, alpha and strip geometry, diagram correctness, central crop safety, exact state/copy treatment, unwanted invented values or logos, and consistency with the final brand guide. No source, prompt, registry, or generated image was edited.

relevant_rules: The Climb — by AI Ascension is the series identity.
Use the warm Ascent Ledger language of paper, ink, amber, branching paths, and restrained editorial typography.
Use visible evidence labels and do not present generated art as gameplay or product evidence.
Use approved generated identity exports when available; do not silently introduce an unverified logo or monogram.

checks: Compared each source with its exact root prompt and matching asset-registry brief.
Verified all seven source hashes, dimensions, and modes against the six supplied generation receipts.

Inspected CAST-05 alpha geometry and the visible strip at native dimensions. Main visible bands were measured at approximately 138 px and 132 px high in 2172 px wide sources, with low-alpha colored speckles outside the bands.

Inspected the proportional central safe crops for MKT-01, MKT-02, and MKT-08 in temporary review derivatives. MKT-01/MKT-02 retain complete text; MKT-08 clips the left side of the heading in the central-80-percent crop.
Inspected CAST-07 connector direction, labels, box count, and the explicit not-a-live-status note.
Compared palette, path treatment, title punctuation, attribution, logos, and invented values with the final brand guide and approved identity references.
not_tested: No final mechanical export was approved.
No CAST-06 title-transition WebM or frame sequencing was run.
No live or recorded broadcast host, stream-status source, or platform publication was run.
No MKT-01 final 2560x1440 export or 6 MB export-cap check was run; only the 1,730,305-byte source was inspected.

crop_reference.basis: The supplied YouTube Help guidance identifies 1235x338 at the 2048x1152 minimum and a proportional 1544x422.5 safe region at 2560x1440. The review mapped that central region to the 1672x941 MKT-01 source as approximately x=332..1340 and y=332..609. MKT-02 used its prompt's central 75-percent width and 60-percent height; MKT-08 used its prompt's central 80-percent width and 65-percent height.
crop_reference.note: This review records source crop observations; it does not attest a platform's current runtime crop behavior or authorize publication.

source_blockers_or_conditions: CAST-05 generation-001 and -002 are visually legible but their main strips are approximately 15.7:1 and 16.3:1, rather than the required 8:1 and 12:1, and both have low-alpha red or green speckle contamination above the top rule.

MKT-01 text is safe in the proportional central crop, but the bright route enters and exits that shallow band. Treat the outer route as decorative in the platform-safe crop or obtain a reflow if the entire route is required to survive.

MKT-02 has a trailing period in The Climb. Existing title lockups and the final brand guide use The Climb without terminal punctuation, so this is a material title-style exactness issue even though it is not a factual claim.

MKT-08 places the heading left of the required central 80-percent crop; a direct central crop visibly clips the leading S. Its status period is grammatical and low-risk, but the literal copy token should still be confirmed before publication.
summary.overall_visual_result: CAST-06 and CAST-07 are clean, readable, and aligned with the brand. MKT-01/MKT-02 have strong source compositions with the stated crop or copy conditions. CAST-05 and MKT-08 need creative correction before their required outputs can be treated as source-ready.
summary.decision: Bounded follow-up source review complete. CAST-06 and CAST-07 may proceed to separate export checks. MKT-01 and MKT-02 remain conditional as recorded. CAST-05 and MKT-08 remain blocked for creative geometry/crop correction. No broadcast-host, deployment, publication, legal, trademark, or public-release approval is made.
